description:
8 printable Christmas games for family nights, classroom parties and office get-togethers. Print, cut and play in minutes.

WHAT YOU GET
• Christmas Bingo: 30 different cards (2 per page) plus 40 calling cards and how-to-play
• Christmas Trivia: 30 multiple-choice questions with an answer key
• Would You Rather: 24 Christmas cards to cut out
• Who's Most Likely To: 24 cards, great for teens and adults
• Word Scramble (20 words), This or That (20 pairs) and an Indoor Scavenger Hunt
• Gift Swap Dice Game for white elephant exchanges, plus a score sheet and 6 prize awards

INSIDE
Cover & game list, Bingo rules & calling cards, 15 pages of bingo cards, Trivia (2 pages), Would You Rather (2 pages), Most Likely To (2 pages), Word Scramble, This or That, Scavenger Hunt, Gift Swap Dice Game, Score sheet, Prize awards, Answer keys.

For personal, family and classroom use. Please don't share or resell the files.

name: Winter Woodland Wall Art, Set of 3
title: Winter Woodland Wall Art Set of 3: Moonlit Pines, Winter Mountains & Winter Berries (Printable)
etsy_title: Winter Wall Art Set of 3, Printable Winter Prints, Mid Century Woodland Moon Mountains Berries, Christmas Decor, Digital Download
description:
Three original mid-century style winter prints that carry your walls from the first frost to the end of February, not just Christmas week.

WHAT YOU GET
• Moonlit Pines: a glowing moon over snowy pines and a little pink cabin
• Winter Mountains: snow-capped peaks, a rose-coloured sun and a still winter lake
• Winter Berries: a minimal botanical branch with red berries on warm cream
• 6 print ratios so they fit standard frames: 2:3, 3:4, 4:5, 11x14, 5x7 and ISO A-sizes
• High-resolution 300 dpi JPGs, up to 24x36 in (2:3) and A2
• Soft navy, sage, teal, cream and berry palette that works with neutral and colourful rooms

INSIDE
Moonlit Pines, Winter Mountains, Winter Berries, 6 ratios, 18 JPG files, Printing guide.

FILES
5 ZIP files of high-resolution JPGs (300 dpi): 2:3, 3:4, 4:5, ISO A-sizes, and 11x14 + 5x7 together. Sizes: 2:3 (4x6, 8x12, 12x18, 16x24, 20x30, 24x36), 3:4 (6x8, 9x12, 12x16, 18x24), 4:5 (8x10, 16x20), 11x14, 5x7 / 10x14, ISO (A5, A4, A3, A2, A1). A printing guide is included.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy and download instantly from your Etsy Purchases page.
2. Unzip the ratio that matches your frame and print at home, at a print shop or with an online photo lab.
3. Frame, hang and enjoy. Frames are not included.
